Deadline Countdown Dashboard

A live dashboard of all your deadlines — add named countdowns that tick every second, saved in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a name and date/time for a deadline.
  2. Press Add — a live countdown card appears.
  3. Watch all your deadlines tick in one dashboard.
  4. Delete finished deadlines with ✕.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where are deadlines stored?

In this browser's localStorage. They persist between visits but don't sync across devices.

Do all countdowns tick live?

Yes — every card shows live days, hours, minutes and seconds, updating every second.

What happens when a deadline passes?

Expired deadlines stay on the board marked as passed so you can review or delete them.
